description: Dose-response of the stem + group-1 freeze at 80% of samples. Base: E116 code. Precondition, free: source hash plus a diff against 82e6219. Change only the freeze point, from 85% to 80% of samples. It stays inside the 32 px / bs-1024 phase, which starts at ~62%. Every freeze x renorm graph and Muon-stack variant is reused unchanged from E116 (already warmed); confirm no recompiles on a 2-trial TORCH_LOGS=recompiles dev run. Accuracy is decided untimed on seeds 3-102 in one fresh process against the pooled ~198-trajectory E116 baseline. Add one scored run with per-trial logs to measure the real saving. Run a 75% arm only if the 85->80 marginal rate comes in at ≤0.04 pp per 1%.
